identity.title: DEBATE: Can We Be Good Without God? | Atheist vs. Theist
identity.dateBasis: YouTube upload date is 2025-01-22; the exact event date is not established. The year labels the published source.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Automatic English captions begin at 0.120 seconds and continue through the final thanks, ending within two seconds of the video duration. Full transcript reviewed; no substantive segment is missing. Automatic spelling errors remain visible and are not silently normalized.

participants.basis: Two invited opposing speakers deliver openings and exchange responses. The moderator recaps their positions and asks practical implications; these are prompts, not an independent case. Students ask questions, not recurring advocacy. Only arguments actually adopted or answered by the two primary speakers are assessed; no host or audience assertion is scored as a third side.

format.motionInterpretation: Both speakers allow that atheists can act well. Their substantive disagreement concerns whether moral truth and humanistic equality require a divine foundation, and whether Christian historical influence establishes philosophical necessity. Pro affirms non-theistic possibility; con defends the Christian grounding without being assigned the claim that atheists cannot behave well.
